name: Silo
subtitle: Apps by Uri
description: Silo Store and the Silo apps.

apps.name: Silo Store
apps.subtitle: Your own app store
apps.localizedDescription: Silo Store installs and refreshes the Silo apps on this iPhone and keeps itself up to date.

apps.name: Silo Gallery
apps.subtitle: Your photos, in your own Silo
apps.localizedDescription: Backs up the photos and videos on this iPhone to your own Silo, and shows your whole Gallery: timeline, albums and a full-screen viewer.

apps.name: Silo Drive
apps.subtitle: Your files, in your own Silo
apps.localizedDescription: Shows your Silo Drive: open, upload, share, rename and delete files, and back up the folders you pick in Files.
